traps.description: The Apple Music receipt is in Spanish. It is still an App Store receipt, and it names the APPLE.COM/BILL charge.
The Paramount+ 'trial ends in 3 days' email is heavy HTML. The trial should still be found.
Lyft charged twice on Sep 29 and refunded one on Oct 3. Nothing is left to dispute.
Mint Mobile bills every 3 months; it is still a bill.
Planet Fitness charges a $49 annual fee under the same name as the $10 monthly fee. The monthly membership should still be found.
The Levoit filter was bought in July 2026; the Levoit HEPA settlement covers 2019 to Aug 2023 purchases only.
The Walmart TV is cheaper now, but Walmart does not adjust prices.
Lufthansa cancelled LH 440 and she accepted the rebooking: EU261 compensation is owed, a cash refund of the fare is not.
Rent by Zelle and the monthly transfer to savings are not subscriptions.
Groceries, gas and coffee are not subscriptions.
